caption:
✍️ No punctuation needed

✅ Rule: Don't separate a noun from the phrase that defines it.
❌ The scientist, Marie Curie, won two Nobel Prizes. (essential name)
✅ The scientist Marie Curie won two Nobel Prizes.
✅ Quick check: If the name identifies WHICH one, no commas.
